title: classify step config
description: Runs a classifier on a context field and writes the top label and its score.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published classifier model.

input_field.description: Context key holding the text to classify; an empty value skips the step with a warning.

output_field.description: Context key receiving the top label; the score lands in <output_field>.score.

threshold.description: Minimum score carried to downstream readers; the executor itself does not filter on it, and 0 is not sent.

labels.description: Labels to classify against, sent with every call in place of the model's own: names, or objects with a name and a description. Needs a zero-shot model (gliner_classifier, gliner_ner, or a decision model published as a classifier); any other model fails the pipeline load. Unset, the model's own labels apply.

label.description: A label name, or an object with the name and a description.

name.description: The label, as the step's results, rules and triggers name it.

description.description: What the label means; the model reads it, so a precise sentence classifies better than a bare word.
